title: 古代事件的先後
Ordering ancient events
question: 展板列出：甲公元前221年、乙公元前500年、丙公元220年。由最早到最遲應怎樣排列？
A display dates A to 221 BCE, B to 500 BCE and C to 220 CE. Which order runs from earliest to latest?
options: 乙→甲→丙
B → A → C
公元前年份數字愈大，年代愈早；兩個公元前事件都早於公元220年。
Larger BCE year numbers are earlier; both BCE events precede 220 CE.
甲→乙→丙
A → B → C
這把公元前的數字當作公元後順序；公元前500年早於公元前221年。
This treats BCE numbering like CE numbering; 500 BCE comes before 221 BCE.
丙→甲→乙
C → A → B
這是由較近至較遠的方向，與題目要求相反。
This runs towards the more distant past, opposite to the requested order.
takeaway: 排列年代前，先分辨公元前與公元後的計年方向。
Distinguish BCE and CE before placing events on a timeline.

title: 河流與文明
Rivers and civilisations
question: 古埃及農民利用尼羅河氾濫後留下的肥沃泥土耕種。哪條因果鏈最能解釋這項環境條件與定居生活的關係？
Ancient Egyptian farmers grew crops in fertile soil left by Nile floods. Which causal chain best links this environment to settled life?
options: 肥沃土壤→較穩定的農業供應→支持定居人口
Fertile soil → a more dependable food supply → support for settled communities
農業剩餘有助支持定居人口，但並不代表每年都沒有旱災或饑荒。
Agricultural surplus can support settlement; it does not mean every year was free of drought or famine.
河流存在→人人不需工作→城市自然出現
A river exists → nobody needs to work → cities appear automatically
河流仍須配合耕作及組織，不會自動提供生活所需。
A river still requires farming and organisation; it does not automatically provide all necessities.
洪水→不能耕種→永久放棄河谷
Floods → no farming is possible → permanent abandonment of the valley
這忽略題目所述氾濫帶來肥沃土壤的作用。
This ignores the fertile deposits described in the question.
takeaway: 歷史因果解釋須指出中間機制，避免把環境視為唯一決定因素。
Explain the mechanism linking an environment to change, without treating geography as the only cause.

title: 陶片能告訴我們甚麼
What can pottery show?
question: 虛構考古練習：兩個相距很遠、年代相近的聚落出土同類陶器。未有文字記錄。哪項是證據最能支持、但仍需覈查的推論？
Fictional archaeology exercise: two distant settlements from a similar period contain similar pottery, with no written records. Which inference is best supported but still needs checking?
options: 兩地可能有交流，須再比較原料與製作方法
The places may have had contact; compare clay sources and production methods
相似器物可提示交流；原料及工藝比較能檢查貿易、仿製等解釋。
Similar objects suggest contact; materials and techniques can test trade, imitation and other explanations.
兩地一定由同一位君主統治
Both places must have had the same ruler
器物相似本身不足以證明政治統治相同。
Similar pottery alone cannot establish common political rule.
兩地的人一定說同一種語言
Everyone in both places must have spoken the same language
陶器形制不能直接證明使用哪種語言。
Pottery form cannot directly establish the language people spoke.
takeaway: 區分器物所顯示的線索與尚未證實的政治或文化結論。
Separate material clues from unproven political or cultural conclusions.

title: 印刷的影響
The effects of printing
question: 研究近代歐洲時，學生比較手抄書與活字印刷。同一篇文字可重複排印，主要直接降低哪項限制？
A class compares manuscripts and movable-type printing in early modern Europe. Reusing type to print the same text most directly reduces which constraint?
options: 每份書都要重新逐字抄寫的時間
The need to copy every book again by hand
重複印製減少每份複本所需的抄寫工作，有助文字流通。
Repeated printing reduces the copying work per copy and helps texts circulate.
讀者必須學習閱讀的需要
The need for readers to learn to read
印刷增加書籍供應，卻不會自動令讀者識字。
Printing increases supply but does not automatically make readers literate.
所有出版物受到審查的可能性
Every possibility of censorship
生產技術改變不等於審查制度必定消失。
A production change does not necessarily remove censorship.
takeaway: 分析技術影響時，要分清直接效果與不一定發生的社會結果。
Distinguish a technology’s direct effects from social outcomes that are not automatic.

title: 工廠選址的改變
Changing factory locations
question: 工業革命課堂模型：甲廠只能用河流水力；乙廠改用燃煤蒸汽機。其他條件相同，乙廠選址的哪項限制最直接減少？
Industrial Revolution classroom model: factory A depends on river power; B uses a coal-fired steam engine. Other conditions equal, which location constraint is most directly reduced for B?
options: 必須靠近合適的急流
Having to be beside a suitable fast-flowing river
蒸汽動力減少對天然流水動力的依賴；燃料及運輸仍然重要。
Steam reduces dependence on flowing water for power; fuel and transport still matter.
必須考慮燃料運輸
Having to consider fuel transport
燃煤蒸汽機需要燃料，運輸限制不會因此消失。
A coal-fired engine needs fuel, so fuel transport remains relevant.
必須有工人操作機器
Having workers operate machinery
動力來源改變，並不代表當時工廠完全不需要工人。
Changing the power source did not make contemporary factories entirely worker-free.
takeaway: 用技術所改變的實際條件解釋工業發展，而非假定所有限制都消失。
Explain industrial change through the specific constraints a technology alters.

title: 十九世紀香港的兩種記錄
Two records of nineteenth-century Hong Kong
question: 以下為虛構教學資料：一份1890年代商會報告說「港口貿易興旺」；工人的日記說「工時長，住處擠迫」。哪個研究結論最合理？
Fictional teaching sources: an 1890s chamber-of-commerce report says port trade is thriving; a worker’s diary describes long hours and crowded housing. Which conclusion is most reasonable?
options: 經濟擴張與工人生活困難可以同時存在
Economic expansion and difficult worker living conditions can coexist
兩份資料關注不同層面；經濟總量增長不表示每個羣體同樣受惠。
The sources address different dimensions; growth does not mean every group benefits equally.
日記必然推翻所有貿易增長資料
The diary necessarily disproves all evidence of trade growth
居住及工時資料不會直接否定貿易量增長。
Housing and working-hour evidence does not directly disprove growing trade.
商會報告足以證明所有居民生活改善
The report proves every resident’s life improved
商會的貿易觀點不足以代表所有居民的生活經驗。
A trade organisation’s account cannot represent every resident’s experience.
takeaway: 比較不同羣體的材料，可辨識同一發展帶來的不均等經驗。
Compare perspectives to recognise uneven experiences within the same historical development.

title: 導火線與長期原因
Trigger and long-term causes
question: 第一次世界大戰前，歐洲存在同盟競爭及軍備擴張；1914年薩拉熱窩刺殺事件加劇危機。哪項最能區分兩類因素？
Before the First World War, Europe experienced alliance rivalry and an arms build-up; the Sarajevo assassination in 1914 intensified the crisis. Which distinction is most useful?
options: 同盟及軍備屬長期背景；刺殺事件是直接導火線之一
Alliances and armaments were longer-term conditions; the assassination was an immediate trigger
這能區分累積的緊張與促使危機迅速升級的事件。
This distinguishes accumulated tensions from an event that rapidly escalated the crisis.
只有先發生的因素纔可能是原因
Only the earliest factor can be a cause
歷史事件可有長期與短期因素共同作用。
Long-term and short-term factors can interact in historical causation.
事件發生在最後，所以必定是唯一原因
The last event must be the sole cause
時間接近不能證明它足以獨自解釋整場戰爭。
Being close in time does not make an event a sufficient explanation of the whole war.
takeaway: 歷史解釋可同時包含結構性背景、促成因素與導火線。
Historical explanations can combine structural conditions, contributing factors and triggers.

title: 國際合作的執行問題
Enforcing international cooperation
question: 教學簡化模型：一個戰後國際組織可以譴責侵略，但執行制裁依賴會員合作。若主要會員拒絕合作，最直接的限制是甚麼？
Simplified teaching model: a post-war international organisation can condemn aggression, but sanctions depend on members’ cooperation. If major members refuse, what is the most direct limitation?
options: 決議與實際執行之間出現落差
A gap develops between a resolution and its enforcement
組織能作出決議，不代表自動取得會員提供的執行資源。
Passing a resolution does not automatically secure resources or action from members.
組織的所有會議記錄立即失效
Every meeting record immediately becomes invalid
執行困難不會令已存在的會議記錄消失或自動失效。
Enforcement problems do not erase or automatically invalidate existing records.
會員之間不再有任何共同利益
Members no longer share any interests
拒絕某項制裁不足以證明所有合作利益均不存在。
Refusing one sanction does not establish that all shared interests have vanished.
takeaway: 分析國際組織時，分辨正式權限、會員意願與執行能力。
Distinguish an international organisation’s formal powers, members’ willingness and practical capacity.

title: 戰後就業結構
Post-war employment structure
question: 虛構香港教學數據：1960年製造業佔就業45%、服務業40%；1990年分別25%、65%。數據最直接支持哪項描述？
Fictional Hong Kong teaching data: manufacturing accounts for 45% of employment and services 40% in 1960; in 1990 they account for 25% and 65%. What do the data most directly support?
options: 就業比重由製造業向服務業轉移
The employment mix shifted from manufacturing towards services
這是比例的變化；沒有總就業數，不能判定製造業人數減少多少。
This describes changing shares; without total employment, the fall in manufacturing headcount is unknown.
製造業就業人數恰好減少20萬
Manufacturing employment fell by exactly 200,000
百分點變化不能直接轉成人數，還需要兩年的總就業數。
Percentage-point changes cannot give headcounts without the totals for both years.
1990年已經沒有製造業
Manufacturing had disappeared by 1990
數據仍列出25%的製造業就業比重。
The data still show manufacturing at 25% of employment.
takeaway: 描述歷史統計時，區分比例、百分點及絕對人數。
Distinguish shares, percentage points and headcounts when using historical statistics.

title: 革命中的延續
Continuity through revolution
question: 研究1911年後的中國。虛構地方檔案顯示：官署名稱改變，但某縣翌年的主要稅收方式維持。哪句最貼合這兩項證據？
A study of China after 1911 uses fictional local records: the government office’s name changes, but one county retains its main tax-collection method the next year. Which statement best fits both?
options: 政治名稱改變，部分地方行政做法仍延續
Political labels changed while some local administrative practices continued
不同層面的變化速度可以不同，兩項證據並不矛盾。
Different dimensions can change at different speeds; the two observations are compatible.
名稱改變證明所有制度立即完全改變
The new name proves every institution changed immediately
名稱是變化證據，卻不能代表所有制度與地方實務。
A new name is evidence of change, not proof about every institution and local practice.
稅收方式延續證明沒有發生任何政治變化
Continuity in taxation proves no political change occurred
一項延續不能抹去官署等其他層面的變化。
One continuity does not erase changes in other dimensions.
takeaway: 以明確層面及時段比較延續與轉變，避免全有或全無的結論。
Compare specified dimensions and periods rather than treating change as all-or-nothing.

title: 宣傳海報的用途
Using a propaganda poster
question: 虛構1930年代政府海報把工廠畫得整潔繁榮，標語鼓勵加入生產。它最直接適合研究甚麼？
A fictional 1930s government poster depicts spotless, thriving factories and urges people to join production. What can it most directly help investigate?
options: 政府希望向公眾塑造的工業形象
The industrial image the government wanted to promote
發行者、畫面與呼籲可顯示宣傳目的；不等於實際工廠普查。
Producer, imagery and appeal reveal promotional intent, not a survey of actual factories.
每間工廠真實的衛生水平
The actual hygiene level in every factory
理想化宣傳圖像不能直接量度所有工廠的環境。
Idealised promotional images cannot directly measure conditions in every factory.
所有工人對政府的私人態度
Every worker’s private attitude to the government
政府發布的海報不是工人的代表性意見調查。
A government poster is not a representative survey of workers’ views.
takeaway: 有立場的史料仍可用；用途須配合它的來源與目的。
A partisan source can be useful when the research question fits its origin and purpose.

title: 反證與有限主張
Counter-evidence and a limited claim
question: 虛構材料：1920年代一份城市婦女雜誌倡議新教育；同年某鄉村入學記錄顯示女童入學仍少。哪項論點能同時處理兩者？
Fictional sources: a 1920s urban women’s magazine advocates new education; a rural enrolment record from the same year shows few girls attending school. Which argument accommodates both?
options: 教育新觀念正在流傳，但實際機會因地區而異
New educational ideas circulated, but access varied by locality
雜誌反映倡議，入學記錄反映一地實況；兩者不能互相替代。
The magazine shows advocacy and the register shows local practice; neither substitutes for the other.
倡議已出現，所以全國男女已平等入學
Advocacy proves equal enrolment nationwide
理念的出現不等於已在所有地方實現。
The appearance of an ideal does not establish universal implementation.
一村女童入學少，所以城市沒有教育改革討論
Low enrolment in one village proves cities had no reform debate
局部實況不能否定另一地區已有的公開討論。
A local outcome does not disprove documented discussion elsewhere.
takeaway: 把思想、政策與落實情況分開，按地域及羣體限定主張。
Distinguish ideas, policy and implementation, and qualify claims by place and group.

title: 冷戰材料的措辭
Language in Cold War sources
question: 兩份虛構冷戰報章談同一援助計劃：甲稱「友好合作」，乙稱「擴大勢力」。單看這兩個詞組，可最有把握指出甚麼？
Two fictional Cold War newspapers describe the same aid programme: A calls it “friendly cooperation”; B calls it “expanding influence”. What can these phrases most securely show?
options: 兩份報章採用不同的評價框架
The newspapers use different evaluative frames
詞語揭示態度差異；要判斷計劃實際效果仍須其他證據。
The wording reveals different attitudes; judging actual effects requires further evidence.
甲必定掌握較多未公開文件
A must possess more confidential documents
正面措辭本身不能證明報章有更多內部資料。
Positive wording alone cannot establish access to more internal documents.
乙所報道的所有數字必然錯誤
Every numerical claim in B must be false
立場可能影響選材，但不能據此判定每項數字皆錯。
A viewpoint may shape selection but does not make every number false.
takeaway: 辨認用語立場後，再逐項覈查事實，不把偏向等同全無史料價值。
Identify framing, then test factual claims individually rather than dismissing an entire source.

title: 口述歷史的追問
Following up oral history
question: 一位受訪者在1980年回憶1950年的遷居：「大家都是為了工作而來。」哪個追問最能改善這項證據的可用性？
In 1980, an interviewee recalls a move in 1950: “Everyone came for work.” Which follow-up best improves the evidence?
options: 你當時親自認識哪些遷居者？他們還提過甚麼原因？
Which migrants did you know personally, and what other reasons did they mention?
追問經驗範圍及其他動機，可檢查「大家」這個概括。
This establishes the scope of direct experience and tests the generalisation “everyone”.
可否把答案說得更有信心？
Could you say that more confidently?
語氣更堅定不會增加記憶或樣本的可靠性。
Greater confidence does not improve the evidence’s memory accuracy or coverage.
我們已知只有工作因素，你同意嗎？
We know work was the only factor; do you agree?
這是引導式提問，容易壓縮或扭曲受訪者的原有經驗。
This leading question may narrow or distort the interviewee’s account.
takeaway: 口述史追問應釐清接觸範圍、時間與記憶，而非誘導預定答案。
Use oral-history follow-ups to clarify scope, timing and memory without steering the answer.

title: 比較不等於因果
Comparison is not causation
question: 虛構1960年代數據：甲地出口增長快且擴建港口；乙地出口增長慢且沒有擴建。兩地同時在教育及市場准入上不同。哪個結論最嚴謹？
Fictional 1960s data: region A expands its port and exports grow rapidly; B does neither. They also differ in education and market access. Which conclusion is most defensible?
options: 港口可能有作用，但須比較其他差異及擴建時間
The port may matter, but other differences and the timing of expansion must be examined
多項條件同時不同，單一比較不足以隔離港口的效果。
Several conditions differ, so one comparison cannot isolate the port’s effect.
出口差距完全由港口擴建造成
Port expansion entirely caused the export gap
這忽略已知的教育及市場條件等其他解釋。
This ignores known alternatives involving education and market access.
存在其他因素，所以港口絕對不可能有影響
Other factors mean the port could have had no effect
其他原因的存在不會排除港口作為共同因素。
Other causes do not exclude the port as a contributing factor.
takeaway: 多因解釋應比較機制、時序及替代因素，而非只找單一相關性。
Evaluate mechanisms, timing and alternatives when constructing a multi-causal explanation.

title: 三篇報道是否三份證據
Are three reports three independent sources?
question: 三份虛構1956年報章報道同一罷工，都註明轉載同一家通訊社。研究者說「已有三個獨立見證」。問題在哪裏？
Three fictional 1956 newspapers report the same strike and credit one news agency. A researcher calls them “three independent witnesses”. What is the problem?
options: 三篇可能共用一個原始消息來源
The reports may share one underlying source
出版於三份報章不等於三次獨立觀察；須追查資料來源。
Three publications do not establish three independent observations; trace their source.
報章不能用作任何歷史研究
Newspapers cannot be used in any historical research
報章可作史料；本題限制是來源重複，並非媒介完全無用。
Newspapers can be evidence; the issue is duplicated sourcing, not a useless medium.
只要文字相同，事件必定沒有發生
Identical wording proves the event never happened
文字共源影響獨立性，不會自行證明事件虛構。
Shared wording affects independence, not whether the event happened.
takeaway: 證據的數量須連同來源獨立性評估。
Assess the number of sources together with their independence.

title: 總量與分配的歷史解釋
Historical totals and distribution
question: 虛構戰後研究：全地區平均實質工資上升，某個工人家庭的日記卻記載生活惡化。哪種處理最合理？
Fictional post-war research shows rising regional average real wages, while one worker’s family diary describes worsening living conditions. What is the best response?
options: 核對家庭收入、就業狀況與開支，檢查平均值掩蓋的差異
Examine the household’s income, employment and expenses for differences hidden by the average
總體平均與個案可同時成立，家庭結構及收入分配值得調查。
An average and an individual case can both be accurate; household circumstances and distribution matter.
刪除日記，因為統計必定適用每個人
Discard the diary because the average applies to everyone
平均值不代表所有家庭都出現同樣變化。
An average does not imply the same change for every household.
只保留日記，因為個案足以推翻全區平均
Keep only the diary because one case disproves the regional average
個案可揭示差異，但本身不能計算或推翻全區平均。
A case can reveal variation but cannot by itself calculate or disprove the regional average.
takeaway: 綜合宏觀與個人史料，先檢查它們是否回答相同層面的問題。
When synthesising aggregate and personal sources, check whether they address the same level of analysis.

title: 有條件的歷史結論
A qualified historical conclusion
question: 虛構改革資料：法令在1905年頒布，1907年只有首都執行，1912年才擴至多個省份。哪句最適合作研究結論？
Fictional reform evidence: a law is issued in 1905, implemented only in the capital in 1907, and extended to several provinces in 1912. Which conclusion best fits?
options: 1905年是法律起點，實際推行分階段且地域不均
1905 marks the legal beginning, while implementation was phased and geographically uneven
結論同時處理頒布、落實時差及地域差異，沒有超出證據。
This accounts for enactment, implementation delays and regional variation without exceeding the evidence.
改革在1905年已於全國完成
The reform was complete nationwide in 1905
法令日期不能當作所有地區完成實施的日期。
The law’s date is not the date of full implementation everywhere.
1912年前沒有任何改革發生
No reform occurred before 1912
1905年的頒布及1907年的首都執行都是較早的變化。
Enactment in 1905 and implementation in the capital in 1907 were earlier changes.
takeaway: 高質素歷史論證以證據限定起點、範圍及變化程度。
A strong historical argument qualifies its timing, scope and degree of change with evidence.

title: 線條的方向感
Directional lines
question: 一幅畫用多條斜線帶領視線向右上方移動。哪個描述直接指出所用的視覺元素？
A drawing uses repeated diagonal lines to lead the eye upwards and right. Which description identifies the visual element?
options: 線條的方向與重複
Direction and repetition of lines
斜線及其重複形成視覺動勢。
Repeated diagonals create directional movement.
色彩的冷暖對比
Warm–cool colour contrast
題目描述斜線的方向，沒有提供色彩冷暖資料。
The prompt describes diagonal direction, not warm or cool colours.
形狀的左右對稱
Left–right symmetry of shapes
對稱關乎兩側對應，不能直接描述斜線引導視線的作用。
Symmetry concerns correspondence across sides, not the stated directional effect.
takeaway: 描述作品時，先指出可觀察的視覺元素及效果。
Describe observable visual elements and their effects.

title: 主體與負空間
Subject and negative space
question: 要畫出兩個杯子之間空隙的形狀，你應集中觀察甚麼？
To draw the shape of the gap between two cups, what should you observe?
options: 由杯子外緣界定的空白形狀
The empty shape bounded by the cups’ edges
負空間是主體周圍或之間的空間，也有可觀察形狀。
Negative space around or between subjects has an observable shape.
杯子內部能盛多少水
How much water the cups hold
容量並不是杯子之間空隙的外形。
Capacity does not describe the gap between the cups.
只記住一般杯子的符號畫法
Only a memorised symbol for a cup
套用符號容易忽略眼前實際的間距及輪廓。
A memorised symbol may miss the actual spacing and contours.
takeaway: 同時觀察主體與負空間，有助檢查比例及位置。
Observing both the subject and negative space helps check proportion and placement.

title: 低彩度中的焦點
A focal point in muted colours
question: 海報大部分用低彩度灰綠色，只有中央一朵花用鮮橙色。哪個理由最能解釋花為何突出？
A poster is mostly muted grey-green, with one bright orange flower in the centre. Why does the flower stand out?
options: 花與背景的彩度及色相形成對比
Its saturation and hue contrast with the background
鮮明程度及顏色差異使視線容易集中在花。
Differences in vividness and hue draw attention to the flower.
橙色物件在所有作品中必定最大
Orange objects must be the largest in every artwork
顏色不會決定物件的實際大小。
Colour does not determine an object’s size.
中央位置令顏色完全沒有作用
A central position makes colour irrelevant
位置與色彩可以共同建立焦點。
Position and colour can work together to establish focus.
takeaway: 解釋焦點時，要連結具體對比與觀者的視線。
Explain a focal point by connecting a specific contrast to the viewer’s attention.

title: 互補色的配搭
Complementary colour pairing
question: 本題使用傳統紅、黃、藍色輪；色輪上藍色的對面是橙色。哪組屬互補色？
Use a traditional red-yellow-blue colour wheel, where orange is opposite blue. Which pair is complementary?
options: 藍與橙
Blue and orange
互補色位於此色輪的相對位置。
Complementary colours occupy opposite positions on this wheel.
藍與藍綠
Blue and blue-green
這兩色相鄰，屬近似色關係。
These are neighbouring, analogous colours.
藍與淺藍
Blue and light blue
這是同一色相的明度變化，不是相對色相。
These differ in value within one hue, rather than being opposite hues.
takeaway: 色彩判斷須說明所用色輪，分辨色相、明度與彩度。
Specify the colour model and distinguish hue, value and saturation.

title: 版印的左右反轉
Reversal in printing
question: 把字母R刻在印版上，想印出方向正常的R。印版上的字母應如何安排？
You carve the letter R into a block and want the printed R to face normally. How should it appear on the block?
options: 先左右鏡像反轉
Reverse it left to right first
印版接觸紙張時，圖像左右方向會反轉。
The printed impression reverses the image left to right.
保持正常方向
Keep it in its normal orientation
這樣印在紙上會得到反轉的R。
This would produce a reversed R on the paper.
只把字母放大
Only enlarge the letter
放大會改變大小，不能處理方向反轉。
Enlargement changes size, not orientation.
takeaway: 瞭解媒材的操作特性，再規劃圖像。
Plan an image around the working properties of its medium.

title: 不用加字的空間感
Creating depth without a label
question: 畫面中甲樹擋住乙樹一部分，甲樹亦畫得較大。若兩棵真樹大小相近，觀者通常會怎樣理解？
Tree A partly overlaps tree B and is drawn larger. If the real trees are similar in size, how will viewers usually read this?
options: 甲樹較靠近觀者
A is closer to the viewer
重疊與相對大小共同提供前後距離線索。
Overlap and relative size jointly suggest depth.
乙樹一定位於甲樹內部
B must be inside A
被遮擋部分不表示一物位於另一物內部。
Partial occlusion does not imply one object is inside another.
兩棵樹必定位於同一平面
Both trees must lie on the same plane
題目提供的重疊與大小線索通常指向不同深度。
The overlap and size cues usually suggest different depths.
takeaway: 空間感可由重疊、相對大小及位置等線索共同建立。
Depth can be constructed through overlap, relative size and placement.

title: 閱讀次序
Reading hierarchy
question: 展覽海報要讓人先讀活動名稱，再看日期，最後看報名細節。哪個安排最符合目的？
An exhibition poster should lead readers from title to date to registration details. Which arrangement best serves this?
options: 標題最突出，日期次之，細節分組並保留間距
Emphasise the title, then the date, grouping details with spacing
大小、位置及留白共同建立資訊層次。
Scale, position and spacing establish an information hierarchy.
全部字體同大，字距全部收窄
Use one size and tightly pack all text
缺乏層次及間距會增加尋找重點的負擔。
Lack of hierarchy and spacing makes key information harder to find.
把日期放在最不顯眼的裝飾內
Hide the date inside a minor decoration
日期是第二重要資訊，不能靠隱藏達成清楚次序。
The second-priority information should not be hidden.
takeaway: 視覺層次須配合資訊優先次序及使用情境。
Match visual hierarchy to information priorities and the viewing context.

title: 灰階後仍可讀
Readable in greyscale
question: 校園地圖以紅色和綠色區分兩條路線，影印成灰階後難以分辨。哪項修改最有效保留區分？
A campus map distinguishes routes in red and green, but they merge in a greyscale photocopy. Which change best preserves the distinction?
options: 一條用實線，一條用虛線，兩者加路線名稱
Use solid and dashed lines and label both routes
線型及文字提供不依靠顏色的資訊。
Line patterns and labels provide information independently of colour.
把紅綠都換成相近深淺的藍色
Replace both with blue shades of similar value
相近灰階明度仍可能難以區分。
Similar values may still be indistinguishable in greyscale.
只把地圖外框加粗
Only thicken the map’s outer border
外框不會改變兩條路線的辨識線索。
The border does not distinguish the routes.
takeaway: 重要資訊應以多於一種視覺線索傳達。
Communicate essential information through more than one visual cue.

title: 對稱不等於唯一平衡
Balance beyond symmetry
question: 構圖左邊有一塊大型淡灰形狀，右邊有一小塊濃黑形狀。評估是否平衡，哪個說法最恰當？
A composition has a large pale-grey shape on the left and a small black shape on the right. Which approach best evaluates balance?
options: 比較面積、明暗、位置產生的視覺重量
Compare the visual weight created by area, value and position
小而濃黑的形狀也可有較強視覺重量，平衡不只看面積。
A small dark shape may carry strong visual weight; area is not the only factor.
只要兩邊面積不同，就必定失衡
Different areas always mean imbalance
非對稱構圖亦可透過不同因素取得平衡。
Asymmetrical compositions can balance through different factors.
只要有黑色，其他元素就完全不影響
Once black appears, other elements have no influence
面積、距離及其他視覺元素仍會共同影響效果。
Area, distance and other elements still contribute.
takeaway: 以視覺重量解釋構圖，而非只套用左右相等的規則。
Analyse balance through visual weight rather than simply requiring equal sides.

title: 媒材與表達
Medium and expression
question: 創作目標是表現邊緣逐漸消散的霧。哪個水彩操作最直接配合此目標？
The artistic aim is to suggest mist with gradually dissolving edges. Which watercolour method most directly supports it?
options: 在濕紙上加水彩，讓色彩柔和擴散
Apply watercolour to wet paper for soft spreading edges
濕畫法可產生柔和滲化，切合題目的邊緣效果。
Wet-on-wet can produce soft diffusion matching the stated aim.
每個色塊都先用防水黑線封邊
Outline every area with waterproof black lines
清楚硬邊通常削弱題目要求的消散感。
Strong hard outlines usually work against dissolving edges.
在乾紙上用少水顏料畫出清晰邊界
Use concentrated paint on dry paper for crisp boundaries
清楚乾燥的邊界較難呈現題目指定的柔和消散。
Crisp dry edges work against the requested soft diffusion.
takeaway: 媒材技巧應有明確表達目的，而非以昂貴程度判斷效果。
Choose techniques for their expressive purpose, not their cost.

title: 詮釋與作品脈絡
Interpretation and context
question: 一件虛構作品用舊車票拼成路線；作者說主題是家人每天往返兩區的生活。哪段評論結合了形式與脈絡？
A fictional artwork arranges used tickets into routes. The artist links it to family journeys between two districts. Which comment connects form and context?
options: 重複車票及交錯路線呼應日常移動與家庭經驗
Repeated tickets and intersecting routes echo everyday movement and family experience
評論把可見材料、組織方式及已提供脈絡連起來。
This links visible materials and organisation with the stated context.
所有舊物必然只代表懷舊
All old objects can only mean nostalgia
這把單一象徵套在所有作品，忽略本作資料。
This imposes one meaning on every work and ignores the supplied context.
作者有家庭，所以作品不需要視覺分析
The artist has a family, so visual analysis is unnecessary
脈絡不能代替對作品形式及材料的分析。
Context does not replace analysis of form and materials.
takeaway: 有根據的詮釋連結可見特徵、材料及具體脈絡。
Support interpretation with visible features, materials and specific context.

title: 策展中的對話
Dialogue between exhibits
question: 展覽主題是「城市的節奏」。甲作以規律重複窗格呈現秩序；乙作以不規則街道線條呈現變化。哪段並置說明最貼題？
An exhibition explores “urban rhythms”. Work A repeats window grids regularly; B uses irregular street lines. Which explanation best justifies showing them together?
options: 兩作以不同節奏處理城市秩序與變化，形成對照
Their contrasting rhythms explore urban order and change
策展理由同時回應主題及兩作的具體形式差異。
The rationale connects the theme to specific formal differences.
只因兩幅作品大小相同
Only because both works have the same size
尺寸方便陳列，但不足以解釋主題關係。
Similar dimensions help installation but do not explain the thematic relationship.
乙作必然比甲作更真實
B must be more truthful than A
不規則形式本身不能證明作品較真實。
Irregular form alone does not establish greater truthfulness.
takeaway: 策展選擇須說明作品之間如何共同建立意義。
Explain how relationships between works contribute to an exhibition’s meaning.

title: 過程記錄的價值
The value of process records
question: 作品集保留三次草圖、修改註解及試材照片。這些資料最直接展示甚麼？
A portfolio retains three sketches, revision notes and material tests. What do they most directly demonstrate?
options: 意念如何經試驗及反思發展
How ideas developed through experimentation and reflection
過程資料可追蹤選擇與修改的理由。
Process evidence traces decisions and reasons for revision.
最後作品必定獲所有觀眾喜歡
That every viewer must like the final work
完整過程不保證所有人的審美反應相同。
A documented process does not guarantee universal approval.
每次修改都一定比前次更好
That every revision was necessarily an improvement
試驗也可能失敗；記錄有助說明如何從中學習。
Experiments may fail; recording them can show what was learned.
takeaway: 作品集應呈現思考與取捨，而不只是最終成品。
A portfolio should reveal reasoning and choices as well as finished work.

title: 一次只改一個設計因素
Testing a design variable
question: 想知道指示牌的字體大小會否影響辨讀距離。哪個比較較能隔離字體大小的作用？
To investigate whether type size affects a sign’s reading distance, which comparison best isolates size?
options: 同樣文字、字體及對比，只改字體大小
Keep wording, typeface and contrast constant; vary type size
控制其他因素可較清楚比較大小的影響。
Holding other factors constant helps isolate size.
同時更換文字、色彩及字體大小
Change wording, colour and size together
多個因素同時改變，不能知道是哪項造成差異。
Several simultaneous changes prevent attribution to size.
讓設計者選自己較喜歡的一張
Ask the designer to choose a personal favourite
喜好不等於實際辨讀距離的測試。
Preference is not a test of reading distance.
takeaway: 設計測試先訂可觀察目標，再控制影響比較的因素。
Define an observable design outcome and control factors that affect the comparison.

title: 再用圖像的清楚署名
Transparent use of an image
question: 教師已準許使用一張授權照片製作拼貼。作品加入自己的裁切、重排及手繪。哪項說明最能清楚交代貢獻？
A teacher has approved a licensed photograph for a collage. The student crops, rearranges and adds drawing. Which note most clearly explains the contributions?
options: 列原照片作者與來源，並說明自己的改動
Credit the photograph’s creator and source and describe the student’s changes
署名與過程說明可區分原素材及新增創作。
Credit and a process statement distinguish source material from new contributions.
只寫「全部由我拍攝」
State “all photography by me”
這與題目中的原照片來源不符。
This contradicts the photograph’s stated origin.
因為加入手繪，就刪除原照片來源
Remove the source because drawing was added
新增創作不會改變原照片的作者身分。
Adding work does not change who created the source photograph.
takeaway: 清楚區分來源素材、使用依據及自己的創作決定。
Distinguish source material, the basis for using it and your own creative decisions.

title: 評論的證據
Evidence in criticism
question: 某評論只說「這雕塑很有張力」。哪項補充能把評語變成可討論的分析？
A review only says “this sculpture has tension”. Which addition makes that judgement analysable?
options: 指出傾斜軸線、狹窄支點及它們造成的不穩定感
Identify its tilted axis, narrow support and the resulting sense of instability
具體形式特徵讓讀者檢查評論與作品的關係。
Specific formal features let readers assess the interpretation.
重複「非常非常有張力」
Repeat “very, very tense”
加強語氣沒有增加可檢查的視覺依據。
Stronger wording adds no observable evidence.
只推斷作者創作時一定很憤怒
Only infer that the artist must have felt angry
作品效果不等於作者當時情緒；仍需具體形式證據。
An artwork’s effect does not establish the artist’s emotions; formal evidence is still needed.
takeaway: 評價應由具體分析支撐，容許他人提出有根據的不同解讀。
Support judgement with analysis that allows informed alternative readings.

title: 修改與創作意圖
Revision and artistic intention
question: 作品意圖表現擁擠都市中的孤立。一位同學建議刪掉所有人物令畫面更整齊。創作者最有理由先問甚麼？
The intention is isolation within a crowded city. A peer suggests removing every figure to make it neater. What should the artist ask first?
options: 刪掉人羣會否削弱「在人羣中孤立」的關係？
Would removing the crowd weaken the idea of isolation among people?
修改須按創作目的評估，整齊並非唯一標準。
Evaluate revision against intention; neatness is not the only criterion.
怎樣修改才會令所有觀眾都同意？
What change will make every viewer agree?
藝術回應可以不同，不能保證全體一致。
Responses to art can differ; universal agreement cannot be guaranteed.
既然有人建議，是否必須全部照做？
Must every suggestion be followed because someone offered it?
同儕回饋是思考材料，不會取代創作者的判斷。
Feedback informs rather than replaces the artist’s judgement.
takeaway: 將回饋與意圖、形式及觀眾反應互相比較，再決定修訂。
Weigh feedback against intention, form and audience response before revising.

title: 可追溯的創作論述
A traceable artistic argument
question: 展覽要求作品回應「記憶不完整」。哪份創作說明最能建立可追溯的意圖、實踐與評估關係？
An exhibition asks artists to address “incomplete memory”. Which process statement best connects intention, practice and evaluation?
options: 說明用破碎照片表現缺口，記錄不同拼接試驗，再比較觀眾是否讀出斷續感
Explain the use of fragmented photos, record assembly trials and compare whether viewers perceive discontinuity
意圖、形式選擇、試驗及回應形成可檢查的發展過程。
Intention, formal choices, trials and responses form a traceable process.
只列最後作品尺寸與售價
List only final dimensions and price
這些資料不能說明作品如何回應主題或經過修訂。
These details do not explain the thematic response or development.
宣稱素材愈多，主題必定愈深刻
Claim that more materials necessarily make the theme deeper
數量不自動構成意義，仍需交代選擇與效果。
Quantity does not automatically create meaning; choices and effects require explanation.
takeaway: 綜合創作與評賞時，建立意圖、證據、試驗和反思之間的關係。
Connect intention, evidence, experimentation and reflection when integrating making and criticism.

title: 四拍小節
A four-beat bar
question: 在4/4拍中，以四分音符為一拍。一小節先有一個二分音符，還需多少個四分音符才完整？
In 4/4, a quarter note is one beat. A bar begins with one half note. How many quarter notes complete the bar?
options: 2個
二分音符佔兩拍，四拍小節還餘兩拍。
The half note occupies two beats, leaving two beats.
1個
兩拍加一拍只有三拍，小節尚欠一拍。
Two plus one gives three beats, one short.
4個
再加四拍會令全小節達六拍。
Adding four beats would make six in total.
takeaway: 計算小節時值時，把音符都轉成相同拍值再相加。
Convert notes to the same beat unit when checking a bar’s duration.

title: 休止仍佔時間
Rests still take time
question: 4/4拍中依次有四分音符、四分休止符、二分音符。第二拍應怎樣做？
A 4/4 bar contains a quarter note, quarter rest and half note in that order. What happens on beat two?
options: 不發聲，但持續數拍
Remain silent but keep counting
休止符是有時值的安靜，不是把一拍刪去。
A rest is timed silence, not a deleted beat.
略過這一拍，立即奏二分音符
Skip the beat and immediately play the half note
略過休止會令節奏提早一拍。
Skipping the rest makes the next note a beat early.
把速度減半
Halve the tempo
休止符本身不要求改變整體速度。
A rest does not itself require a tempo change.
takeaway: 穩定拍子在發聲和休止時都持續存在。
The underlying pulse continues through notes and rests.

title: 拍子與節奏
Pulse and rhythm
question: 甲同學穩定地每秒拍一下；乙同學在同樣時間內拍出長短不同的組合。兩人的配合最能示範甚麼？
Student A taps steadily once a second while B performs a pattern of unequal durations over the same time. What does this best demonstrate?
options: 穩定拍子可承託不同節奏
A steady pulse can support different rhythms
拍子提供規律時間框架，節奏安排長短及重音。
Pulse supplies a regular framework; rhythm organises durations and accents.
只要節奏改變，拍子必須停止
The pulse must stop whenever the rhythm changes
不同節奏可以共用同一穩定拍子。
Different rhythms can share one steady pulse.
較多聲響必定代表速度較快
More sounds always mean a faster tempo
較細的音符可在原有速度內增加聲響數量。
Shorter notes can increase note density without changing tempo.
takeaway: 分辨速度、拍子和節奏密度，避免把音符多誤當加速。
Distinguish tempo, pulse and rhythmic density.

title: 附點音符
Dotted notes
question: 附點增加原音符一半的時值。以四分音符為一拍，附點二分音符有多少拍？
A dot adds half the note’s original value. With a quarter note as one beat, how many beats is a dotted half note?
options: 3拍
3 beats
二分音符兩拍，加一半即一拍，共三拍。
A half note is two beats; adding half of that gives three.
2.5 beats
附點增加原音符的一半，不是固定加半拍。
The dot adds half the note’s value, not always half a beat.
4拍
4 beats
四拍是二分音符的兩倍，不是增加一半。
Four beats doubles rather than adds half to the original.
takeaway: 附點按原音符的時值計算，不是固定加某個拍數。
Calculate a dot from the original note’s value.

title: 旋律與伴奏織體
Melody and accompaniment
question: 一名歌手唱清楚的旋律，鋼琴以和絃伴奏。哪個描述最符合此織體？
A singer carries a clear melody while a piano supplies chordal accompaniment. Which texture best fits?
options: 主調織體：主旋律配和聲伴奏
Homophonic: a main melody with harmonic accompaniment
主旋律最突出，其餘部分提供和聲支持。
The melody leads while other parts provide harmonic support.
單音織體：只有一條無伴奏旋律
Monophonic: one unaccompanied melodic line
題目已有鋼琴和絃伴奏，不是單一旋律線。
The piano chords mean there is more than one melodic line alone.
複調織體：多條同等突出的獨立旋律
Polyphonic: several equally prominent independent melodies
題目描述主旋律與和絃伴奏，不是多條同等獨立的旋律。
The prompt describes a lead melody and chords rather than several independent melodic lines.
takeaway: 根據聲部之間的關係描述織體，而非只數樂器。
Describe texture through relationships between parts, not simply the number of instruments.

title: 樂段與曲式
Sections and form
question: 一首短曲先奏樂段A，再奏新樂段B，最後原樣重奏A。最簡潔的曲式標記是甚麼？
A short piece presents section A, then contrasting B, then repeats A unchanged. What is the simplest form label?
options: ABA
ABA
結尾回到原來樂段，形成三段體。
The return of the opening section creates ternary form.
AB
AB
這遺漏了最後返回A的部分。
This omits the final return to A.
ABC
ABC
最後是A重現，不是第三個全新樂段。
The ending repeats A rather than introducing a third new section.
takeaway: 以材料是否重現或對比來標記曲式。
Label form by identifying returning and contrasting material.

title: 旋律移調
Transposing a melody
question: 把C–D–E整體向上移大二度，並保持各音間距。結果是甚麼？
Transpose C–D–E up a major second, preserving intervals. What results?
options: D–E–F♯
D–E–F♯
每個音都上移兩個半音；E上移後是F♯。
Each note rises two semitones; E becomes F-sharp.
D–E–F
D–E–F
E至F只有一個半音，沒有保持原來最後的全音距離。
E to F is only one semitone and changes the final whole-step interval.
D–F–A
D–F–A
這改變了音程關係，並非整體等距移調。
This changes the intervals rather than shifting the whole melody equally.
takeaway: 移調時每個音都移相同音程，不能只換起音。
Transpose every note by the same interval, not just the starting note.

title: 三和絃的構成
Building a triad
question: 以C大調第1、3、5級音建立主三和絃，應包含哪些音？
Build the tonic triad from degrees 1, 3 and 5 of C major. Which notes belong?
options: C、E、G
C, E and G
C大調第1、3、5級依次是C、E、G。
Degrees 1, 3 and 5 in C major are C, E and G.
C、D、E
C, D and E
這是第1、2、3級的相鄰音，並非指定三和絃。
These are adjacent degrees 1, 2 and 3, not the specified triad.
D、F、A
D, F and A
這是由第2級開始的三和絃，不是主和絃。
This is a triad built on degree 2, not the tonic.
takeaway: 用調式中的音級理解和絃功能，與單純連續音階區分。
Use scale degrees to understand chords and distinguish them from consecutive scale notes.

title: 力度不等於速度
Dynamics are not tempo
question: 樂譜標示由p漸強至f，但沒有改變速度記號。最貼合記譜的演奏是甚麼？
A score moves from p to f through a crescendo without a tempo change. Which performance best follows it?
options: 逐漸增加音量，維持原有拍速
Gradually grow louder while maintaining the pulse
漸強處理力度；沒有加速記號時不應自動加速。
A crescendo changes dynamics; it does not automatically require acceleration.
逐漸加快，但音量完全不變
Accelerate while keeping loudness unchanged
這把力度指示誤當成速度指示。
This mistakes a dynamic instruction for a tempo instruction.
只把所有音提高八度
Raise every note by an octave
改變音區並不等於按要求漸強。
Changing register is not the requested crescendo.
takeaway: 分別處理力度、速度與音高的記譜訊息。
Read dynamic, tempo and pitch information as distinct musical dimensions.

title: 複合拍子的重拍
Beats in compound metre
question: 在通常的6/8拍中，六個八分音符分成兩組，每組三個。主要拍子通常有多少個？
In a usual 6/8 pattern, six eighth notes form two groups of three. How many main beats are normally felt?
options: 2個附點四分音符拍
2 dotted-quarter beats
每組三個八分音符構成一個主要拍子。
Each group of three eighth notes forms one main beat.
6個二分音符拍
6 half-note beats
這既改變時值單位，也與每小節六個八分音符不符。
This changes the duration unit and does not match six eighth notes.
3個附點四分音符拍
3 dotted-quarter beats
三個附點四分音符共九個八分音符，超出6/8小節。
Three dotted quarters equal nine eighth notes, exceeding the bar.
takeaway: 複合拍子要區分主要拍子與其三等分細分。
In compound metre, distinguish main beats from their three-part subdivisions.

title: 終止式的功能
The function of a cadence
question: 在C大調樂句末，G大三和絃接C大三和絃，即V–I。這通常帶來哪種效果？
At the end of a C-major phrase, G major moves to C major, or V–I. What effect does this normally create?
options: 由屬和絃解決至主和絃的結束感
A sense of resolution from dominant to tonic
V–I把和聲帶回主和絃，常用來建立結束感。
V–I returns the harmony to the tonic and commonly supports closure.
必定轉到一個完全不相關的調
An inevitable move to an unrelated key
此處V–I在原來C大調內完成，不必轉調。
This V–I occurs within C major and does not require modulation.
必定令拍號由4/4變成3/4
An inevitable metre change from 4/4 to 3/4
和絃進行不會自行決定拍號改變。
A chord progression does not itself determine metre.
takeaway: 把和聲功能與調性關係連起來，而非與速度或拍號混淆。
Connect harmonic function with tonality rather than tempo or metre.

title: 保留動機的發展
Developing a motif
question: 原動機是「短、短、長」的節奏，上行三個音。哪種改寫最清楚保留節奏身分，同時發展旋律？
A motif uses a short–short–long rhythm and three rising notes. Which variation retains its rhythmic identity while developing the melody?
options: 保留短短長，把音高走向改為下行
Keep short–short–long but make the pitches descend
節奏身分保持，音高輪廓改變，形成可辨認的變奏。
The rhythm remains recognisable while the contour changes.
把節奏及所有音程都換成無關材料
Replace both rhythm and intervals with unrelated material
缺少共同特徵，較難聽出與原動機的關係。
Without shared features, the connection to the motif becomes weak.
完全照奏原動機，不作任何改變
Repeat the motif with no change
這是重複，沒有題目要求的旋律發展。
This is repetition without the requested melodic development.
takeaway: 動機發展在保留可辨認特徵與引入變化之間取捨。
Motivic development balances recognisable identity and change.

title: 切分音的重音
Syncopated emphasis
question: 4/4拍中，一個音在第2拍後半拍開始，延續跨過第3拍的開始。這種安排可產生甚麼效果？
In 4/4, a note begins on the second half of beat 2 and sustains across the start of beat 3. What effect can this create?
options: 弱位置的起音跨過強位置，形成切分效果
An off-beat onset carried across a stronger position creates syncopation
聲音在弱位置開始並跨越拍點，打破預期重音。
The off-beat onset across the beat disrupts expected emphasis.
拍號必然變為5/4
The metre necessarily changes to 5/4
切分可發生在原有4/4框架內。
Syncopation can occur within the original 4/4 metre.
音高必然上升
Pitch must rise
節奏位置不會自行決定音高走向。
Rhythmic placement does not determine pitch direction.
takeaway: 切分改變重音與起音的關係，不一定改變拍號。
Syncopation changes the relation of onset to metrical emphasis without necessarily changing metre.

title: 配器中的遮蓋
Masking in an arrangement
question: 柔和木管旋律被同音區的厚重銅管伴奏掩蓋。若要保留木管為主角，哪項修改最直接？
A soft woodwind melody is masked by dense brass accompaniment in the same register. To keep the woodwind prominent, which revision is most direct?
options: 降低伴奏力度並減薄同音區聲部
Reduce accompaniment dynamics and thin its parts in that register
減少音量及音區競爭可改善旋律清晰度。
Reducing loudness and register competition can improve melodic clarity.
只把木管樂譜紙印大
Only print the woodwind part on larger paper
排版不會改變實際音響平衡。
Page layout does not alter the sounding balance.
增加更多同音區銅管聲部
Add more brass parts in the same register
這通常加重遮蓋問題，與目標相反。
This generally increases the masking rather than resolving it.
takeaway: 配器考慮音色、音區、力度和織體的互相作用。
Consider interactions among timbre, register, dynamics and texture in orchestration.

title: 音高變化與速度變化
Pitch change and speed change
question: 數碼軟件把一段錄音的播放速度由100%改為120%，而沒有啟用音高保留功能。通常會出現甚麼？
Audio software plays a recording at 120% speed without pitch preservation. What usually happens?
options: 時間縮短，音高也上升
Duration decreases and pitch rises
直接提高播放取樣速度通常同時改變時長與頻率。
Faster sample playback normally changes both duration and frequency.
時間縮短，但音高必定完全不變
Duration decreases but pitch must remain unchanged
保持音高需要額外處理；題目明確沒有啟用。
Pitch preservation requires additional processing, which is excluded here.
時間增加，音高下降
Duration increases and pitch falls
這較符合降低播放速度，而非提高至120%。
That describes slower rather than faster playback.
takeaway: 分析音訊工具時，分清一般變速與保留音高的時間伸縮。
Distinguish ordinary speed changes from pitch-preserving time stretching.

title: 有證據的演奏比較
Evidence-based performance comparison
question: 兩次演奏同一樂句。甲每個音等長等強；乙在高潮增加力度、句末稍放鬆。哪段比較最有音樂依據？
Two performances use the same phrase. A gives each note equal duration and emphasis; B grows towards the climax and relaxes at the end. Which comparison is best supported?
options: 乙以力度及句末處理塑造樂句方向
B shapes the phrase through dynamics and ending treatment
評論直接引用已描述的可聽特徵。
This refers directly to the described audible features.
乙全曲必定比甲更快
B must be faster throughout the piece
力度及句末處理不能證明全曲速度都較快。
Dynamic shaping and an ending do not establish a faster overall tempo.
甲的音高一定較不準確
A must have less accurate pitch
題目沒有提供音準資料，不能作此比較。
No pitch-accuracy evidence is provided for this comparison.
takeaway: 音樂評論應討論可聽證據，不猜測演奏者背景。
Discuss audible evidence rather than guessing a performer’s background.

title: 選擇適合的創作修訂
Choosing a purposeful composition revision
question: 短曲想表現「漸漸聚集的力量」，但整段只有同一力度的單音旋律。哪個修訂最能建立漸進發展？
A piece aims to convey “gathering strength” but remains a single melody at one dynamic level. Which revision best creates gradual development?
options: 逐步增加聲部密度及力度，保留主要動機
Gradually add textural density and dynamics while retaining the main motif
多個參數有方向地發展，且動機維持整體連貫。
Directed change across parameters builds momentum while the motif maintains coherence.
在最後一秒突然插入完全無關的強音
Insert an unrelated loud sound in the final second
突發強音不等於整段逐漸聚集的過程。
A sudden loud event is not a gradual build-up.
只更改曲名，不改聲音
Only change the title
曲名不能代替音樂中可聽到的發展。
A title cannot substitute for audible musical development.
takeaway: 創作修訂須讓聽者在聲音組織中感受到意圖。
Make an artistic intention audible through the organisation of sound.

title: 公平比較混音版本
Comparing mixes fairly
question: 同一演奏有兩個混音版本。B整體音量較大，試聽者因而覺得「細節較清楚」。要比較混音清晰度，最先應怎樣改善測試？
Two mixes use the same performance. B is louder and listeners call it “clearer”. What should be improved first when comparing clarity?
options: 以相近的感知音量播放，再比較聲部可辨程度
Match perceived loudness, then compare how clearly parts can be distinguished
控制音量差異可減少把「較響」誤作「較清楚」的偏差。
Loudness matching reduces the bias of treating louder as clearer.
只保留B，因為較響就是音質較好
Keep only B because louder means better quality
音量是比較中的混雜因素，並不直接等於清晰度。
Loudness is a confound, not the same as clarity.
把兩個版本改成不同樂曲
Replace them with different pieces
改曲會增加新的差異，更難比較混音本身。
Different music introduces further differences and weakens the comparison.
takeaway: 錄音評估須控制比較條件，再用明確音樂準則判斷。
Control listening conditions and use explicit musical criteria when evaluating recordings.

title: 找到指定版本
Finding a specified edition
question: 虛構書目練習：老師指定閱讀《城市樹木》陳文著、2022年版。目錄出現三本同名書。最應先核對哪組欄位？
Fictional catalogue exercise: A teacher assigns City Trees by Chan Man, 2022 edition. The catalogue shows three books with that title. Which fields should you check first?
options: 作者及出版年／版本
Author and publication year/edition
同名書未必同作者或同版本，這些欄位可確認指定書目。
A shared title does not guarantee the same author or edition.
封面顏色及書本厚度
Cover colour and thickness
外觀不能可靠辨識指定作者和版本。
Appearance does not reliably identify the assigned author and edition.
借閱次數及評分
Loan count and rating
人氣不能確定是否指定的版本。
Popularity does not identify the required edition.
takeaway: 查找指定資源時，使用完整書目資料而非只看書名。
Use complete bibliographic details when locating a specified resource.

title: 書架排序
Shelf order
question: 本館此書架按索書號數值由小至大排列：510、512.4、513。索書號512.37的書應放在哪裏？
This shelf orders call numbers numerically: 510, 512.4, 513. Where should 512.37 go?
options: Between 510 and 512.4
512.37 is less than 512.40 and greater than 510.
Between 512.4 and 513
37與4不能當作整數直接比較；應比較小數值。
Do not compare 37 and 4 as integers; compare the decimal values.
513之後
After 513
512.37 is still smaller than 513.
takeaway: 依圖書館指定的排序規則逐部分比較索書號。
Follow the library’s stated filing rules when comparing call numbers.

title: 為問題選資料
Choosing a source for a question
question: 你要知道校內圖書館「今天幾點關門」。哪項來源最直接合適？
You need to know when the school library closes today. Which source is most directly suitable?
options: 圖書館今天發布的開放時間通知
Today’s opening-hours notice from the library
問題關乎今天的安排，應查負責單位最新通知。
The question concerns today, so use the responsible service’s current notice.
三年前的校慶特刊
A school anniversary booklet from three years ago
舊刊可提供歷史資料，卻未必反映今天安排。
It may provide historical information but not today’s schedule.
一本介紹世界圖書館的百科全書
An encyclopaedia about libraries worldwide
內容範圍太廣，不能直接回答本校今天的時間。
Its scope does not answer today’s local schedule.
takeaway: 來源是否合適，取決於問題的時間、地點和用途。
A source’s suitability depends on the question’s time, place and purpose.

title: 擴闊同義詞搜尋
Searching synonyms
question: 資料庫把OR解釋為「符合任何一個詞」。要同時找到使用teenagers或adolescents的文章，應輸入甚麼？
A database defines OR as matching either term. Which search finds articles using teenagers or adolescents?
options: teenagers OR adolescents
teenagers OR adolescents
OR把兩組結果合併，有助涵蓋不同用語。
OR combines result sets to cover different terminology.
teenagers AND adolescents
teenagers AND adolescents
AND要求兩詞同時出現，可能漏掉只用其中一詞的文章。
AND requires both terms and may exclude articles using only one.
teenagers NOT adolescents
teenagers NOT adolescents
NOT會排除含adolescents的結果，與目標相反。
NOT excludes results containing adolescents, contrary to the aim.
takeaway: 搜尋同義或相關詞時，可用OR擴闊覆蓋；AND用來交集。
Use OR to cover alternatives and AND to intersect concepts.

title: 縮窄過廣搜尋
Narrowing a broad search
question: 研究題目是「香港中學生的睡眠習慣」。只搜尋sleep得到太多無關結果，哪個修訂最聚焦？
A project concerns sleep habits among Hong Kong secondary students. Searching sleep returns too much irrelevant material. Which revision is most focused?
options: sleep AND "Hong Kong" AND "secondary students"
sleep AND "Hong Kong" AND "secondary students"
加入地點和研究對象，讓搜尋對應題目範圍。
Adding location and population aligns the search with the topic.
sleep OR holidays OR animals
sleep OR holidays OR animals
增加無關的OR詞組會擴大而非聚焦結果。
Unrelated OR terms broaden rather than focus the results.
刪去sleep，只搜尋students
Remove sleep and search only students
這失去主題限制，可能得到更多不相關內容。
This removes the topic constraint and may add irrelevant results.
takeaway: 把研究題目拆成主題、對象及情境，再組合搜尋詞。
Break a research topic into concept, population and context when choosing search terms.

title: 摘要與原文
Abstract and full text
question: 搜尋結果摘要說研究「可能有幫助」。你準備引用具體改善幅度，下一步最需要甚麼？
A search abstract says an intervention “may help”. You want to cite the size of the improvement. What do you need next?
options: 閱讀原文的方法及結果，確認數值與適用對象
Read the full methods and results to check the value and population
摘要未提供所需數據，原文可確認量度方式及條件。
The abstract lacks the required detail; the paper explains measurement and conditions.
把「可能」改成「一定」，使文章更清楚
Replace “may” with “definitely” for clarity
這提高了確定程度，卻沒有增加證據。
This increases certainty without adding evidence.
只引用搜尋結果的排序位置
Cite only its position in the search results
排序不是研究效果大小的證據。
Search rank is not evidence of effect size.
takeaway: 引用精確結果前，核對原文中的方法、數值與範圍。
Check methods, values and scope in the original before citing a precise result.

title: 改寫仍須引用
Paraphrasing still needs a citation
question: 你用自己的句子概括一篇文章的核心論點，沒有逐字抄寫。應如何交代？
You summarise an article’s central argument in your own words without copying its wording. How should you acknowledge it?
options: 保留原意，並註明文章來源
Preserve the meaning and cite the article
表達方式改變，論點來源仍需要交代。
Changing the wording does not remove the source of the idea.
因為字句不同，所以不用引用
Do not cite because the wording differs
引用不只用於直接引文，也用於借用的觀點。
Citation also acknowledges borrowed ideas, not just quotations.
加引號，但不寫來源
Use quotation marks without a source
引號用於準確直接引文，亦不能代替來源資料。
Quotation marks indicate exact wording and do not replace attribution.
takeaway: 區分直接引文與改寫，兩者都要讓讀者追查來源。
Distinguish quotation from paraphrase and make both traceable.

title: 引用是否真的支持
Does the citation support the claim?
question: 文章說「所有學生都偏好電子書」，引用的調查卻只訪問圖書學會20名會員，其中12人偏好電子書。哪句修訂符合資料？
An article claims all students prefer e-books. Its cited survey asked 20 library-club members, of whom 12 preferred e-books. Which revision fits?
options: 受訪的20名會員中，有12人偏好電子書
Of the 20 club members surveyed, 12 preferred e-books
保留樣本範圍及實際結果，沒有推廣至全校。
This retains the sample and result without generalising to the whole school.
所有會員及全校學生都偏好電子書
All members and all students prefer e-books
樣本內也不是人人偏好，更不能推廣至未受訪者。
Not even all respondents preferred them, and others were not surveyed.
只有12名學生懂得使用電子書
Only 12 students know how to use e-books
偏好調查沒有量度使用能力。
The survey measured preference, not ability.
takeaway: 檢查引用是否支持主張的對象、數量及確定程度。
Check whether a citation supports a claim’s population, quantity and certainty.

title: 版本更正
Corrections and versions
question: 某研究原報告寫40%，更正公告說因資料輸入錯誤應為30%。你尚未交功課，最合理的處理是甚麼？
A report originally states 40%; a correction changes it to 30% after a data-entry error. Your assignment is not yet submitted. What should you do?
options: 採用更正值，並記錄所引用的更正版本
Use the corrected figure and record the corrected version
最新更正直接影響數值，引用須讓讀者辨識版本。
The correction changes the value; the citation should identify the version.
保留40%，因為先看到的版本較可靠
Keep 40% because the first version you saw is more reliable
先看到不代表正確，且已有明確更正。
Seeing a version first does not make it more accurate.
Average 40% and 30% to get 35%
舊值是已知輸入錯誤，不是可與新值平均的獨立估計。
The old value is a known error, not an independent estimate to average.
takeaway: 研究記錄應保留版本資訊，並處理已發布的更正。
Track versions and account for published corrections.

title: 把概念變成量度
Operationalising a concept
question: 研究「圖書館是否更方便使用」，哪個變項最直接量度找書效率？
To study whether the library is easier to use, which variable most directly measures book-finding efficiency?
options: 在相同找書任務中完成所需時間
Time to complete the same book-finding task
明確任務與時間可形成可比較量度。
A defined task and completion time provide a comparable measure.
受訪者喜歡的書封顏色
Respondents’ favourite cover colours
封面喜好並非找書效率的直接量度。
Cover preference does not directly measure search efficiency.
圖書館名稱有多少個字
The number of letters in the library’s name
名稱長度沒有直接量度使用者完成任務的效率。
Name length does not directly measure task efficiency.
takeaway: 把抽象概念轉成與研究問題相關、可重複量度的指標。
Translate an abstract concept into relevant, repeatable measures.

title: 避免引導式問卷
Avoiding a leading survey
question: 想了解新自修室的使用經驗，哪個問題最中立？
Which question most neutrally investigates experiences of a new study room?
options: 你使用自修室時，哪些安排有幫助，哪些有困難？
Which features helped you, and which caused difficulties?
問題容許正面、負面或混合經驗，不預定結論。
It allows positive, negative or mixed experiences without presupposing a result.
你是否同意這間出色的自修室應立即擴建？
Do you agree this excellent room should be expanded immediately?
「出色」及擴建主張已引導評價方向。
“Excellent” and the expansion claim steer the response.
為何新自修室浪費大家時間？
Why does the new room waste everyone’s time?
問題先假定負面效果，無法中立收集經驗。
This assumes a negative effect before collecting evidence.
takeaway: 問卷措辭應讓不同經驗都能被表達。
Phrase surveys so different experiences can be expressed.

title: 自選樣本
Self-selected samples
question: 網上閱讀問卷只在閱讀獎勵羣組發布，80%的回覆者每天閱讀。最重要的推論限制是甚麼？
A reading survey is posted only in a reading-award group; 80% of respondents read daily. What is the main limitation?
options: 羣組成員及自願回覆者可能較喜歡閱讀
Group members and volunteers may be more interested in reading
招募途徑與自選回覆可能偏向特定習慣。
Recruitment and self-selection may favour particular habits.
只要有百分率，就已代表全校
A percentage automatically represents the school
百分率不能消除取樣偏差。
Expressing a result as a percentage does not remove sampling bias.
所有回覆必定是假資料
Every response must be fabricated
代表性不足不等於個別回覆必定造假。
Limited representativeness does not mean responses are fabricated.
takeaway: 評估調查時，先問誰有機會被邀請及誰選擇回覆。
Ask who could be recruited and who chose to respond.

title: 相對增加與基準
Relative growth and the baseline
question: 報告標題說「借閱量增加100%」，正文說由每週2本增至4本。哪個摘要最完整？
A headline says borrowing rose 100%; the report specifies an increase from two to four books weekly. Which summary is most informative?
options: 每週由2本增至4本，增加2本，即100%
Weekly borrowing rose from 2 to 4 books: 2 more, or 100%
同時列基準、絕對差和相對變化，有助理解規模。
The baseline, absolute difference and relative change clarify the scale.
借閱量增加100本
Borrowing rose by 100 books
100%是相對比例，不是增加100本。
100% is a relative change, not 100 additional books.
因為增幅大，所以已證明政策成功
The large percentage proves the policy succeeded
兩個數值不會自行證明因果或政策成效。
Two figures alone do not establish causation or policy success.
takeaway: 報道百分率時，保留基準和絕對數，避免放大印象。
Report baselines and absolute values alongside percentages.

title: 區分觀察與實驗
Observational and experimental evidence
question: 研究發現常到圖書館的學生平均成績較高，但沒有隨機分配使用次數。哪個結論最合適？
Students who visit the library often have higher average grades, but visits were not randomly assigned. Which conclusion is best?
options: 兩者有關聯，但學習動機等因素也可能影響結果
There is an association, but motivation and other factors may contribute
觀察性比較不能單獨排除共同影響因素。
An observational comparison cannot by itself exclude confounders.
每多到圖書館一次都必然令成績上升
Every extra visit necessarily raises a student’s grade
研究沒有隔離每次到訪的因果效果。
The study did not isolate the causal effect of each visit.
兩者沒有任何關係，因為不是實驗
There is no relationship because it was not an experiment
觀察資料仍可顯示關聯，只是因果推論有限。
Observational data can show association despite limited causal inference.
takeaway: 研究設計決定可作出的推論，不把關聯寫成已證實因果。
Match the strength of a conclusion to the study design.

title: 有系統地找反方證據
Searching beyond agreement
question: 研究者主張延長開放時間有效，卻只搜尋「延長開放的好處」。怎樣改善文獻搜尋最合適？
A researcher argues that longer opening hours help but searches only for “benefits of longer hours”. What best improves the search?
options: 加入成效有限、成本及不同情境的搜尋詞，記錄納入準則
Search also for limited effects, costs and contexts, recording inclusion criteria
搜尋設計須容許找到挑戰原有主張的資料。
A search should be capable of finding evidence that challenges the initial claim.
只增加更多「好處」同義詞
Add only more synonyms for benefits
這可能增加數量，但仍保留同一方向的選材偏差。
This may add results while retaining the same directional bias.
遇到不同結論就刪除文章
Delete any article reaching another conclusion
依結論篩選會令綜合失去公正的證據基礎。
Filtering by conclusion undermines a fair synthesis.
takeaway: 搜尋及納入準則應先於結論，避免只收集支持自己的資料。
Set search and inclusion criteria independently of the desired conclusion.

title: 引用鏈與原始研究
Citation chains and original studies
question: 五篇網誌都引用同一項研究，卻沒有新增資料。作證據綜合時，應如何計算獨立研究數目？
Five blog posts cite the same study and add no new data. How should a synthesis count independent studies?
options: 這條引用鏈只有一項原始研究
This citation chain contains one original study
轉述次數不會增加獨立研究或樣本數。
Repeated reporting does not add independent studies or participants.
共有六項互相驗證的研究
There are six mutually confirming studies
原研究加五篇轉述不是六次獨立調查。
One study plus five reports is not six independent investigations.
網誌沒有新增資料，所以原研究也不存在
Because the blogs add no data, the original study does not exist
二手報道無新增證據，不代表原研究不存在。
Secondary repetition does not erase the underlying study.
takeaway: 追溯到原始資料，避免把多次轉述重複計入證據。
Trace original data to avoid double-counting repeated reports.

title: 結果不同如何綜合
Synthesising different results
question: 研究甲：有導師支援的初學者進步；研究乙：獨立使用同一工具的熟練者沒有明顯進步。哪個綜合最合理？
Study A finds gains for beginners with tutoring; B finds no clear gains for experienced users working alone with the same tool. Which synthesis is most reasonable?
options: 效果可能與原有能力及支援條件有關，需比較設計
Effects may depend on prior skill and support; compare the study designs
兩項研究的對象及條件不同，不能只把結果視為直接矛盾。
Different participants and conditions mean the findings are not simply contradictory.
兩個結論互相抵消，所以不需再看方法
The findings cancel out, so methods are irrelevant
研究結果不能像相反數字般直接抵消。
Findings cannot simply be cancelled like opposite numbers.
只選自己較喜歡的一項
Choose only the study you prefer
個人喜好不能代替方法與適用範圍的比較。
Preference cannot replace comparing methods and scope.
takeaway: 證據綜合要解釋差異可能來自甚麼，而非只統計支持或反對篇數。
Synthesis should explain differences rather than merely count favourable and unfavourable studies.

title: 可重做的研究記錄
A reproducible research record
question: 同學要依你的文獻搜尋重做一次。哪組記錄最能協助重現？
A classmate wants to repeat your literature search. Which record best supports replication?
options: 資料庫、日期、完整搜尋式、篩選準則及排除原因
Databases, dates, full queries, selection criteria and exclusion reasons
這些資料讓他人理解如何找到及選擇證據。
These details reveal how evidence was located and selected.
只列最後三篇最喜歡的文章
Only the final three favourite articles
結果清單沒有交代搜尋範圍和篩選過程。
A final list does not document search scope or selection.
只保存文章封面的截圖
Only screenshots of article covers
封面通常不包含重做搜尋所需的方法資訊。
Covers usually lack the methodological details needed.
takeaway: 透明研究須保存搜尋與選擇過程，讓限制可被檢查。
Document search and selection processes so the research and its limits can be examined.

title: 傳球後的支援
Supporting after a pass
question: 三人傳球練習中，你把球傳給隊友後，怎樣最有助下一次配合？
In a three-player passing drill, what best supports the next move after you pass?
options: 移到可接應的空位，讓持球者看見你
Move into visible space to offer a return pass
移動可建立新的傳球角度，避免與持球者擠在一起。
Movement creates a new passing angle instead of crowding the ball carrier.
一直跟在持球者身後貼近他
Stay immediately behind the ball carrier
這容易重疊位置，減少可用傳球角度。
This crowds the same space and reduces passing options.
傳球後完全停止觀察場面
Stop watching the play after passing
支援需要持續留意隊友、防守者及空位。
Support requires continued awareness of players and space.
takeaway: 球類配合不只看持球動作，也看無球時的位置。
Team play depends on off-ball positioning as well as actions with the ball.

title: 身體平衡
Body balance
question: 在老師指導的靜態平衡示範中，其他條件相同，哪個姿勢通常較穩定？
In a teacher-led static-balance demonstration, other conditions equal, which position is generally more stable?
options: 支撐面較闊，重心較低
A wider base of support and a lower centre of gravity
較闊支撐面及較低重心通常增加抗傾倒的穩定性。
A wider base and lower centre of gravity generally improve resistance to tipping.
支撐面較窄，重心較高
A narrower base and a higher centre of gravity
這通常令身體較容易失去平衡。
This generally makes loss of balance easier.
支撐面不變，只把重心升得更高
Keep the base unchanged but raise the centre of gravity
其他條件相同，提高重心通常不會增加靜態穩定性。
Other conditions equal, raising the centre of gravity generally does not improve static stability.
takeaway: 以重心及支撐面解釋穩定性，並在教師安排下練習。
Explain stability through centre of gravity and base of support in supervised practice.

title: 清楚的比賽訊號
Clear signals in a game
question: 小組遊戲用哨聲表示停止，但有同學未能清楚聽到。怎樣保留同一規則並改善全組參與？
A group game uses a whistle to signal stop, but some players cannot hear it clearly. How can the same rule be made accessible?
options: 同步使用大家先練習過的明顯手勢或旗號
Pair the whistle with a visible gesture or flag practised by everyone
多種訊號傳達同一指令，讓所有人及時理解。
Multiple signals communicate the same instruction in time.
只要求沒聽到的人退出
Require those who missed it to leave
退出沒有改善訊號，也減少參與機會。
Exclusion does not improve the signal and reduces participation.
隨機更改停止的意思
Randomly change what stop means
規則不一致會令所有人更難安全配合。
Inconsistent meanings make coordinated play harder.
takeaway: 清楚、一致及可感知的規則訊號有助安全參與。
Clear, consistent and perceptible signals support safe participation.

title: 訓練頻率
Training frequency
question: FITT中的frequency指頻率。計劃由每週兩次活動改為三次，而每次時長和強度不變，主要改了甚麼？
In FITT, frequency describes how often activity occurs. A plan changes from two sessions weekly to three, with duration and intensity unchanged. What changes?
options: 頻率
Frequency
改變的是每週次數，而非每次時間或強度。
The number of weekly sessions changes, not session duration or intensity.
每次時長
Duration per session
題目已說每次時長不變。
The question states that session duration stays the same.
活動類型
Activity type
題目沒有更換活動種類。
No change of activity type is stated.
takeaway: 用頻率、強度、時間與類型分開描述活動計劃。
Describe frequency, intensity, time and type separately.

title: 技能回饋的焦點
Focused skill feedback
question: 傳球練習後，哪句回饋最能讓同學知道下一次要改甚麼？
After a passing drill, which feedback most clearly identifies what to change next?
options: 「傳球前先望接球者，確認他已準備好。」
“Look at the receiver before passing and check they are ready.”
回饋指出可觀察、可實行的一項動作。
It identifies one observable and actionable behaviour.
「你永遠都不擅長球類。」
“You are always bad at ball games.”
固定標籤沒有提供改進方法。
A fixed label offers no method for improvement.
「總之做得好一點。」
“Just do better.”
說法太籠統，沒有指出可調整的行動。
This is too vague to identify a change.
takeaway: 有效回饋針對可改變的動作，而非給人固定能力標籤。
Useful feedback targets adjustable actions rather than fixed ability labels.

title: 控制球場空間
Using playing space
question: 進攻時四名隊員全擠在持球者旁邊，防守者容易封鎖傳球。哪個調整最能改善局面？
Four attackers crowd around the ball carrier, making passes easy to block. Which adjustment best improves the attack?
options: 拉開適當距離，形成不同方向的接應點
Spread out to create receiving options in different directions
寬度及不同角度可增加防守者要覆蓋的空間。
Width and varied angles increase the space defenders must cover.
全部再靠近持球者
Move everyone even closer to the ball
這會進一步減少空間與傳球選擇。
This further reduces space and passing options.
只增加傳球力度，不改站位
Pass harder without changing positions
力度不能直接解決路線被集中封鎖的問題。
Power alone does not solve blocked passing lanes.
takeaway: 戰術選擇要回應空間、隊友及對手的位置。
Base tactical choices on space and the positions of teammates and opponents.

title: 速度的量度
Measuring speed
question: 教學數據：一名學生用20秒跑100米，平均速度是多少？
Teaching data: a student covers 100 metres in 20 seconds. What is the average speed?
options: 5米／秒
5 m/s
平均速度＝距離÷時間＝100÷20。
Average speed equals distance divided by time: 100 ÷ 20.
這把時間除以距離，單位也不是速度。
This divides time by distance rather than distance by time.
距離乘時間不會得到速度。
Multiplying distance by time does not give speed.
takeaway: 運動數據應同時核對計算方法及單位。
Check both the calculation and its units when analysing performance data.

title: 動作學習的練習安排
Practice for skill learning
question: 初學者剛學會一個基本傳球動作。老師想先讓他穩定掌握，再適應變化。哪個安排較符合這個次序？
A beginner has just learned a basic pass. The teacher wants consistency first, then adaptation. Which sequence fits?
options: 先在穩定條件重複，再逐步改變距離及接應位置
Repeat under stable conditions, then gradually vary distance and receiver position
先建立動作，再加入變化，可配合不同學習階段。
Establishing the action before adding variability fits different learning stages.
首次就同時改變所有條件且不給回饋
Change every condition immediately and provide no feedback
大量新變項會令初學者難以找出動作問題。
Many new variables make it harder for a beginner to identify errors.
永遠只練一個固定情境
Practise one fixed situation forever
這可建立熟悉感，卻不足以練習情境適應。
This builds familiarity but does not develop adaptation.
takeaway: 練習結構應配合技能熟練程度及所需遷移。
Match practice structure to skill stage and transfer needs.

title: 勝負以外的體育精神
Sportsmanship beyond winning
question: 在自行裁判的友誼賽，你清楚看到己方球員最後碰球出界，但對方未看見。哪個行動符合雙方事前同意的誠實報界規則？
In a self-officiated friendly game, you clearly see your teammate touch the ball last before it goes out; opponents miss it. What follows the agreed honest-calling rule?
options: 主動指出己方最後觸球，按規則交球
Acknowledge your team’s last touch and award possession by the rules
遵守已同意的規則需要在對己方不利時也誠實報告。
Following the agreement includes honest calls when they disadvantage your team.
因為沒有裁判，就可隨時更改規則
Change the rule because no referee is present
自行裁判仍依靠共同規則，並非沒有規則。
Self-officiating still depends on shared rules.
只在己方領先時才誠實報界
Make honest calls only when your team leads
按比分選擇是否守規則並不一致。
Applying honesty selectively by score is inconsistent.
takeaway: 體育精神包括一致遵守共同規則與承擔責任。
Sportsmanship includes consistent rules and responsibility.

title: 訓練的專項性
Training specificity
question: 兩個課堂訓練例子：甲反覆練短距離快速起步，乙做持續較長時間的穩定活動。甲較直接針對哪項能力？
Two classroom examples: A practises repeated short, fast starts; B performs steady activity for longer periods. Which ability does A target more directly?
options: 起步加速表現
Starting acceleration
短距離快速起步較接近加速動作的要求。
Fast short starts more closely match the demands of acceleration.
長時間持續活動能力
Capacity for prolonged continuous activity
這較接近乙的練習形式。
That more closely matches B’s activity.
讀懂比賽規則的速度
Speed of reading game rules
題目練習的是身體動作，沒有直接訓練閱讀。
These are movement tasks, not direct reading practice.
takeaway: 訓練適應與練習所施加的具體要求有關。
Training adaptations relate to the specific demands practised.

title: 衝量與接球
Impulse and catching
question: 簡化力學模型：同一顆球以相同速度到達，最後都停止。若接球時把減速時間延長，平均作用力通常怎樣變化？
Simplified mechanics: the same ball arrives at the same speed and is brought to rest. If stopping time increases, what normally happens to average force?
options: 減少
It decreases
動量改變相同時，平均力＝動量改變÷作用時間。
For the same momentum change, average force equals that change divided by time.
增加
It increases
在相同動量改變下，時間增加會使平均力減少。
With momentum change fixed, increasing time reduces average force.
必定變成零
It must become zero
只要球的動量改變，有限時間內仍需要作用力。
Changing momentum over a finite time still requires force.
takeaway: 把運動技巧與作用時間、動量改變及平均力連繫。
Connect movement technique with contact time, momentum change and average force.

title: 技能成功率的比較
Comparing skill success rates
question: 虛構練習：甲近距離射門10次中8次，乙遠距離射門10次中6次。能否只憑數字判定甲的射門能力較高？
Fictional practice: A scores 8 of 10 close shots; B scores 6 of 10 long shots. Can these figures alone rank their shooting skill?
options: 不能；距離不同，應在可比較條件再測
No; distances differ, so retest under comparable conditions
難度條件不同，成功率不能直接作相同能力的比較。
Different difficulty conditions prevent a direct like-for-like comparison.
能；8永遠代表比6更高的能力
Yes; 8 always represents greater ability than 6
得分數未反映兩種任務的難度差異。
The counts do not account for different task difficulty.
不能，因為成功率完全沒有用途
No, because success rates are entirely useless
成功率有用，但須配合相同或已調整的條件。
Success rates are useful when conditions are comparable or adjusted.
takeaway: 比較運動表現前，確認任務難度和量度條件相稱。
Check task difficulty and measurement conditions before comparing performance.

title: 開放與閉鎖技能
Open and closed skills
question: 以下哪項較接近開放技能：環境會改變，運動員需即時適應？
Which task most closely illustrates an open skill, requiring adaptation to a changing environment?
options: 比賽中因應對手移動選擇傳球路線
Choosing a pass as opponents move during a game
對手及隊友動態變化，需要持續調整。
Changing players’ positions require ongoing adjustment.
在固定環境獨自投向同一靜止目標
Throwing alone at the same stationary target in fixed conditions
環境較穩定、可預測，較接近閉鎖技能。
The stable, predictable environment is closer to a closed skill.
在固定位置、無對手幹擾時自行決定發球時間
Serving at a chosen moment from a fixed position without opponent interference
這個起始環境較穩定且可自行控制時間，較接近閉鎖技能。
The initial environment is stable and self-paced, closer to a closed skill.
takeaway: 技能分類要看環境可預測程度及所需即時調整。
Classify skills by environmental predictability and adaptation demands.

title: 速度測試的可靠性
Reliability of a speed test
question: 兩次短跑測試的起跑提示、距離、地面及計時方法都不同。要提高重測可靠性，應先怎樣做？
Two sprint tests use different start cues, distances, surfaces and timing methods. What should be done first to improve test–retest reliability?
options: 標準化上述程序，安排一致的測試條件
Standardise procedures and keep testing conditions consistent
減少量度程序差異，較能比較同一表現。
Reducing procedural variation makes repeated measurements more comparable.
只記錄較快的一次並刪掉其他資料
Keep only the faster trial and delete the rest
選擇性保留無法改善測試程序，也掩蓋變異。
Selective recording does not improve the procedure and hides variability.
每次更換全新的測試方法
Use an entirely new test each time
方法更不一致，重測比較更困難。
Greater inconsistency makes repeated comparison harder.
takeaway: 可靠性關乎一致量度，不等於只挑看來最好的結果。
Reliability concerns consistent measurement, not selecting the best-looking result.

title: 回饋逐步減少
Reducing feedback gradually
question: 同學已能穩定完成技能，卻每次都要等教練立即評語。若目標是提升自我判斷，哪個安排較合適？
A learner performs consistently but waits for immediate coaching after every attempt. To develop self-evaluation, which arrangement is more suitable?
options: 先讓他自評，再間歇提供具體回饋
Ask for self-evaluation first, then provide specific feedback intermittently
自評與逐步減少外來提示可練習獨立辨識動作效果。
Self-evaluation and reduced external prompting develop independent error recognition.
每個動作都增加更多即時指令
Add more immediate instructions to every movement
這可能加強依賴，而不是自我判斷。
This may increase dependence rather than self-evaluation.
從此不准他尋求任何回饋
Never allow feedback again
完全禁止回饋不等於有計劃地發展自我調節。
Banning all feedback is not a planned approach to self-regulation.
takeaway: 按學習階段調整回饋頻率，逐步培養自主監察。
Adjust feedback frequency to develop self-monitoring as skill grows.

title: 效度與測試目的
Validity and test purpose
question: 老師想量度球員的傳球決策能力，卻只用100米跑時間排名。主要問題是甚麼？
A teacher wants to assess passing decisions but ranks players solely by 100-metre sprint time. What is the main problem?
options: 測試與要量度的能力不相符
The test does not match the intended ability
跑速可量度速度，卻未直接觀察傳球判斷。
Sprint time measures speed, not passing decisions directly.
只要秒錶準確，便能量度任何能力
An accurate stopwatch can measure any ability
量度準確不等於測到正確構念。
Precise measurement does not guarantee the right construct is measured.
所有體育測試都不能提供資料
No sports test can provide information
問題在測試選擇，不是所有測試皆無用。
The issue is test selection, not the usefulness of all testing.
takeaway: 先界定學習目標，再選能直接觀察該能力的量度。
Define the learning objective before selecting a measure that captures it.

title: 觀察者評分的一致性
Consistency between observers
question: 兩位評判用同一張傳球決策量表，對同段影片評分差距很大。哪個改善最直接？
Two assessors use the same passing-decision rubric but give very different scores to one video. Which improvement is most direct?
options: 共同評分示例，釐清各級描述及分歧
Score examples together and clarify criteria and disagreements
以示例校準判斷可改善評判對準則的共同理解。
Calibration with examples improves shared interpretation of criteria.
把兩人的分數相加就當作沒有分歧
Add their scores and treat the disagreement as resolved
加總不能解釋或改善評分差異的原因。
Adding scores does not resolve why they differ.
刪去量表，只憑印象
Remove the rubric and rely on impressions
缺乏清楚準則通常更難保持一致。
Removing clear criteria generally makes consistency harder.
takeaway: 評分工具需要清楚準則及共同校準，而不只是同一張表格。
A shared rubric needs clear criteria and calibration, not merely an identical form.

title: 調適後仍評核同一目標
Adapting access without changing the goal
question: 課堂目標是傳球決策，某同學需要較慢的比賽節奏。哪個調適最能保留目標？
The lesson assesses passing decisions, and one student needs a slower pace. Which adaptation best preserves the objective?
options: 降低整組移動速度，仍要求觀察空位並選擇傳球
Slow the group’s movement while retaining choices based on available space
調整參與條件，同時保留觀察及決策的核心要求。
This changes access conditions while retaining observation and decision-making.
替該同學決定每次傳球對象
Choose every receiver for the student
這移除了要評核的決策本身。
This removes the decision-making being assessed.
只讓他抄寫比賽規則，當作完成傳球決策
Replace the task with copying rules and count it as passing decisions
抄寫規則沒有展示在場上的觀察與選擇。
Copying rules does not demonstrate decisions in play.
takeaway: 包容調適應區分參與障礙與真正要學習、評核的能力。
Distinguish access barriers from the actual learning and assessment target.

title: 有限資源與選擇
Scarcity and choice
question: 班會只有一小時場地時間，但兩個活動各需完整一小時，不能同時進行。問題最直接反映哪個概念？
A class has one hour of venue time, but two activities each require a full hour and cannot run together. Which concept is illustrated?
options: 資源有限，必須作出選擇
Limited resources require a choice
可用時間不足以同時滿足兩項用途，因此要取捨。
Available time cannot meet both uses, so a choice is necessary.
只要活動免費，就沒有資源限制
Free activities face no resource constraints
金錢不是唯一資源，時間及場地仍有限。
Money is not the only resource; time and space are limited too.
所有人的偏好必定相同
Everyone must have identical preferences
資源限制並不決定大家有相同偏好。
Resource scarcity does not determine people’s preferences.
takeaway: 免費不等於沒有成本；時間、空間及人力同樣有限。
Free admission does not remove constraints on time, space and labour.

title: 機會成本
Opportunity cost
question: 你只有足夠時間參加一項活動，偏好次序是籃球、戲劇、棋藝。若選籃球，最主要放棄的下一最佳選擇是甚麼？
You have time for one activity and rank basketball first, drama second and chess third. If you choose basketball, what is the next-best alternative forgone?
options: 戲劇活動
Drama
機會成本是所放棄的下一最佳選擇，不是所有選項相加。
Opportunity cost is the next-best alternative forgone, not the sum of all alternatives.
戲劇和棋藝的全部價值總和
The combined value of drama and chess
你本來也不能同時參加兩者，不能把它們全部相加。
You could not take both, so their values should not simply be added.
籃球活動本身
Basketball itself
籃球是得到的選擇，不是放棄的替代方案。
Basketball is the chosen activity, not the alternative forgone.
takeaway: 分析選擇時，找出真正可行的下一最佳替代方案。
Identify the feasible next-best alternative when analysing a choice.

title: 活動預算
An activity budget
question: 虛構班會預算：收入600元，場地200元，材料每人15元，共20人。活動後餘額是多少？
Fictional class budget: income is $600, venue cost $200, and materials cost $15 each for 20 students. What remains?
options: 這只扣了一人的材料費，漏算其餘19人。
This subtracts materials for only one student.
只扣材料費會漏掉200元場地開支。
Subtracting only materials omits the $200 venue cost.
takeaway: 預算要區分固定開支和隨人數改變的開支。
Distinguish fixed costs from costs that vary with participation.

title: 按單位比較價格
Comparing unit prices
question: 同款果汁：甲600毫升售12元，乙1000毫升售18元。只比較每100毫升價格，哪個較低？
The same juice costs $12 for 600 mL or $18 for 1000 mL. Which has the lower price per 100 mL?
options: 乙，每100毫升1.8元
B, at $1.80 per 100 mL
甲每100毫升2元，乙1.8元；比較需使用相同單位。
A costs $2 per 100 mL and B $1.80; use a common unit.
甲，因為總價12元較少
A, because $12 is the smaller total
總價較低不代表每單位較便宜。
A lower total price does not mean a lower unit price.
兩者相同，因為是同款果汁
They are equal because the juice is the same
產品相同也可能有不同包裝單價。
Identical products can have different unit prices.
takeaway: 單價有助比較，但購買時仍要考慮實際需要與可用預算。
Unit prices support comparison, alongside actual need and available budget.

title: 需求增加的模型
A rise in demand
question: 簡化市場模型：學校紀念冊供應量暫時固定，更多人願意在原價購買。其他條件不變，市場價格通常面對哪種壓力？
Simplified market model: yearbook supply is fixed in the short run and more people want to buy at the original price. Other things equal, what price pressure arises?
options: 上升壓力
Upward pressure
原價下需求增加而供應未增，出現向上的價格壓力。
Higher demand with unchanged supply creates upward price pressure.
下降壓力，因更多人想買就會自動增加供應
Downward pressure because more buyers automatically create more copies
需求增加不會自動增加題目中暫時固定的供應。
Extra demand does not automatically expand the stipulated fixed supply.
完全沒有任何壓力，因為印製成本未改
No pressure because printing costs are unchanged
市場價格也受需求與供應影響，不只看成本。
Market price depends on demand and supply as well as cost.
takeaway: 在「其他條件不變」的模型中，分別分析需求與供應的變動。
Analyse demand and supply changes separately under an other-things-equal assumption.

title: 可比較的消費資訊
Comparable consumer information
question: 兩款水樽都聲稱「更耐用」，但測試方法不同。哪項資訊最有助有根據地比較？
Two bottles both claim to be more durable but use different tests. Which information best supports a reasoned comparison?
options: 相同條件的測試方法、結果及限制
Methods, results and limitations from comparable test conditions
同條件資料較能比較產品表現，而不只是廣告措辭。
Comparable conditions support a performance comparison beyond advertising language.
只比較兩款廣告對「耐用」一詞的使用次數
Only count how often each advert says “durable”
宣傳次數不能代替可比較的產品測試。
Repetition of a claim cannot replace comparable product testing.
只看哪個售價較高
Only which costs more
售價較高並不直接證明相同測試下更耐用。
A higher price does not prove better durability under the same test.
takeaway: 消費判斷應檢查主張的量度方式、比較基準及限制。
Assess how consumer claims are measured, compared and qualified.

title: 第三者受到的影響
Effects on third parties
question: 午間音樂活動令參加者開心，但鄰近自修室使用者難以集中；他們沒有參加活動。哪項分析最準確？
A lunchtime music event benefits participants but distracts nearby study-room users who are not taking part. Which analysis fits?
options: 活動對非參與者產生外部影響
The activity creates an external effect on non-participants
影響落在活動參與者以外的人身上，也應納入決策。
Effects on people outside the activity should also be considered.
只要參加者滿意，就沒有其他影響
If participants are happy, there are no other effects
這忽略題目中已出現的第三者影響。
This ignores the stated effects on third parties.
所有音樂活動必須永久取消
Every music event must be permanently cancelled
指出外部影響不等於只有取消一種處理方法。
Recognising an external effect does not make cancellation the only response.
takeaway: 公共決策須考慮直接參與者以外的人受到的影響。
Consider effects on people beyond the direct participants in a public decision.

title: 共同資源的安排
Managing a shared resource
question: 自修室有20個座位，30名學生同時需要使用。若目標是讓更多人有合理使用機會，哪個方案最直接處理座位限制？
A study room has 20 seats and 30 students need it at once. Which plan most directly addresses capacity while broadening access?
options: 公佈分時段預約及合理使用時限，並檢查實際需求
Publish timed bookings and reasonable limits, then review demand
時段安排把有限容量分配到不同時間，亦可依需求調整。
Time slots distribute limited capacity over time and can be adjusted to demand.
讓最早到的20人每天整天保留座位
Let the first 20 arrivals keep their seats all day
這雖容易執行，卻未增加其餘學生的使用機會。
This is simple to administer but does not broaden access for the remaining students.
容許首批使用者永久保留座位
Let the first users reserve seats permanently
這可能排除後來有需要的人，沒有增加使用機會。
This can exclude later users rather than broaden access.
takeaway: 共同資源分配須有清楚程序，並按實際使用情況檢討。
Use clear procedures and review real usage when allocating shared resources.

title: 多數意見的界限
Limits of a majority view
question: 80%的受訪者贊成把通知只放在手機應用程式，但部分學生沒有合適裝置。決定前最應補充哪項資料？
Eighty percent of respondents favour app-only notices, but some students lack a suitable device. What additional information matters most before deciding?
options: 無法使用的人數、原因，以及可行的替代接收方法
How many cannot access it, why, and what alternative delivery is feasible
多數偏好不能回答少數是否會失去必要資訊。
Majority preference does not establish whether others would lose essential information.
只計算全校平均每人擁有多少部裝置
Only calculate the average number of devices per student
平均數可能掩蓋有人沒有合適裝置，仍未回答誰無法接收通知。
An average can conceal students with no suitable device and does not identify who misses notices.
假定未回覆者全部同意
Assume every non-respondent agrees
未回覆不能當作贊成，也不能忽略其接收限制。
Non-response is not agreement and may reflect access barriers.
takeaway: 使用調查結果時，同時檢查未被平均數或多數票反映的需要。
Examine needs that averages or majority preferences may hide.

title: 名義收入與購買力
Nominal income and purchasing power
question: 教學模型：每月零用錢由100元增至110元，同一籃物品價格由100元增至120元。購買同一籃物品的能力如何變化？
Teaching model: monthly allowance rises from $100 to $110, while the same basket of goods rises from $100 to $120. What happens to purchasing power?
options: 下降，因收入增幅低於該籃物品價格增幅
It falls because income grows less than the basket’s price
原先可買一籃，現在110÷120不足一籃。
The allowance previously bought one basket; 110 ÷ 120 now buys less than one.
上升，因為收到的金額增加
It rises because the cash amount increases
名義金額增加不代表相對價格後的購買力增加。
More cash does not necessarily mean greater purchasing power after price changes.
不變，因兩項都增加10%以上
It is unchanged because both increase by at least 10%
兩項增幅不同，不能因同樣上升就視為抵消。
Different growth rates do not cancel merely because both rise.
takeaway: 比較生活負擔時，區分金額變化與相對價格後的購買力。
Distinguish nominal amounts from purchasing power after price changes.

title: 事實判斷與價值判斷
Factual and value judgements
question: 以下哪句主要是可用資料檢查的事實主張，而非對應然分配的價值判斷？
Which statement is primarily an empirically testable claim rather than a value judgement about allocation?
options: 新安排下，每週可預約時段由10個增至14個
Under the new plan, weekly bookable slots rose from 10 to 14
可以核對時間表驗證數量變化。
Timetables can verify the numerical change.
所有人都應優先選自己最喜歡的時段
Everyone should have priority for their favourite slot
「應」表達分配上的價值立場，需討論準則。
“Should” expresses an allocation principle that requires evaluation.
公平一定比效率更重要
Fairness must always matter more than efficiency
這是對價值優先次序的判斷，不能只用時段數證明。
This ranks values and cannot be proved solely by counting slots.
takeaway: 分辨可查證的實然主張與需說明理由的價值立場。
Distinguish testable descriptive claims from value positions requiring justification.

title: 諮詢的代表性
Representation in consultation
question: 新校園路線只諮詢每天坐校車的學生，但方案也改變步行者和輪椅使用者的出入口。哪個補充最能改善諮詢？
A route plan consults only school-bus users but changes entrances for walkers and wheelchair users too. What best improves the consultation?
options: 讓受影響但未被訪問的使用者試走並提供回饋
Invite affected, previously unconsulted users to test the routes and comment
補足使用經驗，有助發現現有樣本未涵蓋的問題。
Additional user experience can reveal problems absent from the initial sample.
只增加更多校車使用者，仍不問其他人
Add more bus users but no other groups
增加相同羣體數量不會填補未涵蓋的經驗。
A larger sample of the same group does not fill the missing perspectives.
只模擬校車上落客時間，代替所有使用者測試
Simulate only bus boarding times instead of testing with all users
這可改善校車資料，卻仍未涵蓋步行及無障礙出入口。
This improves bus data but still omits walking and accessible entrances.
takeaway: 諮詢品質不只看人數，也看是否涵蓋受影響的經驗。
Consultation quality depends on coverage of affected experiences, not only headcount.

title: 利益衝突的程序
A conflict-of-interest procedure
question: 學生委員會選活動供應商，一名委員的家人擁有其中一家公司。最能維持可檢查決策程序的安排是甚麼？
A student committee selects an event supplier; one member’s family owns a bidding company. Which procedure best supports an accountable decision?
options: 申報關係，按既定規則退出相關評分，由其他人按同一準則評估
Declare the connection and follow recusal rules, with others using the same criteria
申報及適當避席可減少私人利益影響評分的風險。
Disclosure and appropriate recusal reduce the risk of private interests shaping the score.
只要委員保證公正，就不用告知其他人
Keep it undisclosed if the member promises fairness
未申報關係令他人無法檢查可能影響判斷的因素。
Undisclosed connections prevent scrutiny of possible influences.
直接選另一家公司，不需比較質素及價格
Automatically choose another company without comparing quality or price
處理衝突不等於放棄透明、一致的評估準則。
Managing a conflict does not remove the need for consistent evaluation criteria.
takeaway: 問責程序要使關係、準則和決定可被檢查。
Accountable procedures make relevant relationships, criteria and decisions examinable.

title: 平均改善與羣體差異
Average improvement and group differences
question: 虛構試行：全校平均排隊時間由8分鐘降至6分鐘，但需要無障礙櫃位者由10分鐘升至15分鐘。哪句最準確？
Fictional pilot: average queuing time falls from 8 to 6 minutes overall, but rises from 10 to 15 for users of an accessible counter. Which statement is most accurate?
options: 整體平均改善，但某羣體的經驗惡化，需分開檢討
The overall average improves while one group fares worse, requiring separate review
分組資料顯示平均值未反映的負擔。
Disaggregated data reveal burdens hidden by the overall average.
所有人都快了2分鐘
Everyone waits 2 minutes less
平均差額不能套用到每個羣體或個人。
An average difference cannot be assigned to every group or person.
只看15分鐘就能判定全校平均上升
The 15-minute figure proves the school-wide average increased
單一羣體結果不能取代題目已提供的整體平均。
One subgroup does not replace the stated overall average.
takeaway: 評估公共方案時，同時看整體效果及負擔如何分配。
Evaluate both overall effects and how benefits and burdens are distributed.

title: 短期成本與持續成本
Initial and recurring costs
question: 兩個活動方案：甲初期300元，其後每月80元；乙初期600元，其後每月20元。若完整使用6個月，哪個總成本較低？
Two plans cost: A, $300 initially plus $80 per month; B, $600 initially plus $20 per month. Over six full months, which total is lower?
options: 甲：只需300元
A: only $300
這漏掉持續六個月的每月費用。
This omits six months of recurring charges.
兩者同為600元
Both cost $600
初期與每月費用必須分別累加，不能忽略其中一項。
Initial and recurring costs must both be counted.
takeaway: 比較方案要選定共同時段，計入初期及持續開支。
Compare plans over the same time horizon, including initial and recurring costs.

title: 準則與可行方案
Criteria and feasible options
question: 學校預算1000元，要求方案至少服務50人且提供無障礙入口。甲900元／60人／有入口；乙800元／70人／無入口；丙1100元／80人／有入口。哪個符合全部既定條件？
A school has $1000 and requires capacity for at least 50 people and an accessible entrance. A: $900/60 people/accessible; B: $800/70/no access; C: $1100/80/accessible. Which meets all conditions?
options: 甲
A
甲符合預算、人數及入口三項限制。
A meets the budget, capacity and access constraints.
乙
B
乙成本較低、人數較多，但未符合無障礙入口條件。
B is cheaper and larger but fails the access requirement.
丙
C
丙雖有人數及入口優勢，卻超出預算。
C meets capacity and access but exceeds the budget.
takeaway: 先識別必須符合的限制，再比較可行方案的優劣。
Identify binding constraints before comparing feasible alternatives.

title: 未回覆者的聲音
Understanding non-response
question: 網上諮詢有40%學生回覆，多數支持方案；未回覆者中有不少較少使用網上平臺。哪個後續最能檢查是否漏掉重要意見？
An online consultation receives responses from 40% of students, mostly supportive; many non-respondents rarely use the platform. What follow-up best checks missing views?
options: 用紙本或面談接觸部分未回覆者，再比較需要與意見
Reach some non-respondents by paper or interview and compare needs and views
改變接觸方式可檢查平臺使用習慣是否造成系統性遺漏。
Another contact method can test whether platform use caused systematic omissions.
把60%未回覆者都算作支持
Count the 60% non-response as support
沉默沒有提供贊成的證據。
Silence supplies no evidence of support.
只把同一網上連結重貼給原來回覆者
Resend the same link only to previous respondents
這沒有接觸原本被漏掉的人。
This does not reach those missing from the initial responses.
takeaway: 未回覆並不等於沒有需要；評估接觸方式對參與的影響。
Non-response does not mean no need; examine how access methods shape participation.

title: 有指標的政策檢討
Reviewing a policy with indicators
question: 新自修室安排目標是縮短等候並保留不同羣體的使用機會。哪個三個月檢討最能回應兩項目標？
A new study-room plan aims to reduce waits while preserving access for different groups. Which three-month review best addresses both?
options: 比較前後等候時間、各羣體成功預約比例及未能使用的原因
Compare waiting times, booking success by group and reasons for failed access
指標直接對應效率和機會分配，並能指出需要修訂之處。
The measures address efficiency and access distribution and can guide revisions.
只看總預約次數增加了多少
Only count the increase in total bookings
總次數不能充分反映等候或哪些羣體未能使用。
Total bookings do not adequately show waits or excluded groups.
只問工作人員是否喜歡新表格
Only ask whether staff like the new form
工作便利可以考慮，但不能取代原定學生使用目標。
Staff convenience matters but does not replace the stated access objectives.
takeaway: 公共方案須把目標轉成可檢查指標，並預留根據結果修訂的機會。
Translate public goals into testable indicators and allow revision based on results.
